reference_set.used_for: Structural patterns only — fixed section order, two-column hero with form, editorial eyebrow + display H2s, service tiles, sub-service check bullets.

rationale.primary: #144E9D is the client's own CSS brand primary and the only chromatic brand value on the site — both logo files sample as pure monochrome white, so there is no other brand ink to derive from. Kept verbatim.
rationale.accent: #F5A623 is a derived industrial safety amber, not a scraped value. Two reasons: (1) the detected blues (#2EA3F2 / #2098D1) are Divi defaults and measure under 1.6:1 against the #144E9D primary panel, so they cannot function as the template's accent-on-dark; (2) safety amber is the colour already present in the client's own floor-line-marking work and hero footage, so it reads as their material rather than as decoration.
rationale.typography: Detected heading font 'Bank Gothic' is proprietary with no Google Fonts equivalent, so the detected BODY font (Red Hat Display) is promoted to display use at heavy weights — it keeps the squared, technical letterform character of the original without substituting an unrelated face. Inter carries body copy.
rationale.radius: Tightened from the template default (4/8/14px) to 3/6/10px. Industrial B2B, not consumer home services.
rationale.contrast_verified: All pairs measured. accent on primary 3.98:1 (non-text/large — clears 3:1, and above the template's own 3.78:1 default). accent_ink on bg 5.47:1 and on surface 5.93:1 (AA). text on bg 16.39:1. muted on bg 6.04:1. on_primary on primary 8.06:1. on_accent on accent 8.48:1.

anti_patterns: generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
homeowner-directed copy or residential urgency language (client-specific: this is a B2B facilities buyer)
autoplaying full-bleed hero video (client-specific: the failure mode of the site being replaced)
